about.title: Engineering Precision & Athletic Drive
about.desc: The Baku Higher Oil School (BHOS) Table Tennis Club unites students, faculty, and staff who share a passion for competitive sport. With professional training facilities, ITTF-approved tables, and a live ELO rating engine, our club empowers athletes to sharpen their skills and compete in campus-wide championships.
about.card1_desc: 4 professional Donic Waldner 25mm tournament tables (1 Ladies / 3 General).
about.card2_desc: Dynamic K=32 two-factor verification algorithm tracking every official match.
about.card3_desc: Daily friendly sparring and ranked matchmaking via the official WhatsApp group.

hall_rules.table1_desc: Exclusively reserved for female athletes, training sessions, and friendly or official matches.
hall_rules.table1_bullet1: Priority access and open practice sessions for female students

hall_rules.tables24_desc: Assigned for daily practice sessions, ELO ladder matches, and friendly games.

hall_rules.t1_usage: Dedicated table for female students' training, friendly rallies, and matches
hall_rules.t2_usage: Primary table for ELO ranked matches, ladder competitions, and training
hall_rules.t3_usage: Technical drills, ranked encounters, and friendly practice matches
hall_rules.t4_usage: Open practice sessions, challenge matches, and daily rallies
hall_rules.rules_header: Official Sports Hall Conduct & Discipline Rules
hall_rules.rules_subheader: Mandatory regulations established by the BHOS Sports Club administration
hall_rules.rule1_desc: Outdoor shoes, boots, or hard-soled footwear are strictly prohibited. Only clean non-marking indoor court sneakers are permitted inside the hall.
hall_rules.rule2_desc: Outerwear is not permitted on the playing floor. Coats and bags must be left in the locker rooms or designated seating areas.
hall_rules.rule3_desc: Profanity and unsportsmanlike language are strictly forbidden. Maintain respectful conduct toward all students and faculty.
hall_rules.rule4_desc: All sports equipment must be used strictly for its intended purpose (table tennis paddles, balls, nets, and tables).
hall_rules.rule5_desc: Familiarize yourself with official ITTF and club regulations and compete fairly within the rules.

facility.title: BHOS Table Tennis Hall & Court Allocation

facility.allocation_desc: Table 1 is strictly dedicated for Girls. Tables 2, 3, and 4 are assigned for Boys & Open Free Play.
facility.equipment_desc: Donic 3-Star ITTF balls and standard club paddles can be collected from the Sports Complex desk.
facility.footwear_desc: Non-marking indoor sports court shoes are strictly required to preserve professional rubberized flooring.

hall_tables.table_1_sub: Dedicated for BHOS Girls & Female Students
hall_tables.table_1_desc: Prioritized exclusively for girls practice sessions, friendly rallies, and official championship fixtures.
hall_tables.table_2_desc: Primary arena table equipped for official BHOS ELO ranked matches, varsity selection trials, and tournament knockouts.
hall_tables.table_3_desc: Specialized for topspin looping, footwork drills, serve-and-attack routines, and training sessions led by Head Coach Iftixar Meherremov.
hall_tables.table_4_desc: Open to all engineering students for casual sparring, doubles matches, and rapid winner-stays-on campus challenges.
